name: Transition Presets
author: The Kinoklip contributors
description: Presets for an edit point: select a clip next to a cut and double-click one in Effects Library > Toolbox > Presets, or drop it on the start or end of a clip.

presets.name: Quick Dissolve
presets.description: A short cross dissolve (12 frames) at the edit point

presets.name: Slow Dissolve
presets.description: A long cross dissolve (48 frames) at the edit point

presets.name: Dip to Black
presets.description: A dip to black (24 frames) at the edit point

presets.name: Cross Zoom Whip
presets.description: A fast zoom blur from one clip to the next (GL Transitions, 18 frames)

presets.name: Whip Pan
presets.description: A quick sideways whip between the clips (GL Transitions, 12 frames)
